transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you're likely aware, the boiler serving the early-childhood wing needs repair, and we need to relocate one of our classrooms for ten school days starting January 8th. The affected classroom serves 20 students and has its own tables, nap mats, and teaching materials. I've reviewed a draft relocation plan that places the class in Room B204, but before I sign off on anything, I'd like to go through our standard check-in process with facilities, the nurse, special education, and food service. Could we start by hearing from each of you on any concerns or considerations related to this relocation?

transcript.text: Ms. Hart, I need to flag a serious facilities concern before we go any further. I inspected Room B204 this morning and found that its required egress door will be blocked by the repair staging, so it cannot safely be used for an early-childhood class during the boiler repair. However, I did confirm with the custodian this morning that the Library has the necessary clearance and available floor area to accommodate the class. I should note that the room-status board has not been updated yet to reflect this, so others may not be aware that the Library is available.
